newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN CUSTOMS SEIZE 43 KG OF HEROIN.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN CUSTOMS SEIZE 43 KG OF HEROIN.

text.p: Bulgarian customs officers said on Friday they had seized 43 kg (94.8 lbs) of heroin smuggled in a Polish-registered mini-bus from Turkey.
The heroin was discovered at the Kapitan Andreevo checkpoint early on Friday at routine customs checks in the trailer of a Mercedes vehicle, customs' directorate spokesman Ivan Kutevski told Reuters.
The two Polish drivers were detained. The heroin, distributed in 86 packages, was concealed in the floor of the trailer, which was coming from Turkey and was bound for western Europe.
Customs did not give a figure for the value of the haul but police officials said the European street value of the haul was some $6.4 million dollars.
Bulgaria, which lies on the so-called "Balkan route" from the Middle East to western Europe, has stopped 217 (478 lb) kg of heroin this year.
